tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Chevreuse expressing love, using only the supplied approved neutral as image reference. Preserve identity, face, skin tone, hair, eyes, costume, accessories, colors and rendering. Preserve her petite Medium Female proportions, purple hair, eyepatch and red-black uniform. Give this emotion its own expressive full-body acting, genuinely varying leg positions, stance, body angle and gestures rather than locking the neutral pose: a visibly tender affectionate smile and softly focused eyes, a gentle turn of the shoulders, one hand near the heart and feet gently staggered. Keep normal pupils. Hands should be simple and readable; each visible hand has one anatomically correct thumb and four fingers connected to one palm and wrist. Do not force hidden digits into view. Exactly two coherent legs and feet; varied bends, steps, stances and angles are welcome. Keep the complete silhouette including hair, headwear, accessories, hands and shoes visible, roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding, without lengthening the body. True transparent background. No scenery, text, UI, weapons, handheld objects, companions, floating effects or ground shadow.
